---
title: "plot_diff_N"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggplot2, here)

# Load in data 
file_name = "N50_t_sigma.rds"
fits = readRDS(here("fits", file_name))

# extract simulated data
sim = map_dfr(fits, ~.x$sim_units, .id = "run") %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run))

# extract diagnostics
dia = map_dfr(fits, ~.x$dia, .id = "run") %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run)) %>% group_by(run) %>% summarise(sum_div = sum(divergent__), div = ifelse(sum(divergent__)>0,1,0), max_t = ifelse(any(treedepth__>=10), 1,0))
```

```{r}
######################
## Plot divergences ##
######################

# Extract Number of Units
sim_N = sim %>% select(run, U) %>% group_by(run) %>% distinct() %>% ungroup() 

# Summarise divergences by U
dia_div = dia %>% left_join(sim_N, by = "run") %>% group_by(U) %>% summarise(mean_div = mean(div))
print(dia_div)

# plot
plot = ggplot(dia_div)+
  geom_bar(aes(x=as.factor(U), y = mean_div), stat = 'identity', col = 'black', linewidth = 1.2, fill = "lightgreen")+
  labs(x="number of units", y = "prop. divergent runs", title = "proportion of divergent runs over # units")+
  theme_classic()+ theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

print(plot)
```

```{r}
###############
## Plot time ##
###############
color_by = "treedepth"

# Extract Number of Units
sim_N = sim %>% select(run, U) %>% group_by(run) %>% distinct() %>% ungroup() 

# Extract time
time = map_dbl(fits, ~.x$time) %>% enframe(name = "run", value = "time") %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run)) %>%  
  left_join(sim_N, by = "run") %>% left_join(dia, by = "run")

# plot time over N
if (color_by == 'treedepth'){
  
  plot = ggplot(time)+geom_point(aes(x=as.factor(U), y=time, col = as.factor(max_t)))+
    stat_summary(aes(x=as.factor(U), y = time, group =1), geom = 'line', fun = 'mean', col = 'salmon', linewidth =1.2)+
    theme_light()+labs(x="number of units",y="run time", title = "running time over different # of units")+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  } else if (color_by == 'div'){
  
      plot = ggplot(time)+geom_point(aes(x=as.factor(U), y=time, col = as.factor(div)))+
        stat_summary(aes(x=as.factor(U), y = time, group =1), geom = 'line', fun = 'mean', col = 'salmon', linewidth =1.2)+
        theme_light()+labs(x="number of units",y="run time", title = "running time over different # of units")+
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  }

print(plot)
```


```{r}
#############################
## Plot parameter recovery ##
#############################

# Extract simulated parameters in a long format
sim_param = map_dfr(fits, ~.x$sim_units, .id = "run") %>% select(t_sigma, t_mu, unit, run, U, t_mu_mu, t_mu_sigma,t_sigma_sigma, t_sigma_mu_log) %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run)) %>% group_by(run) %>%  distinct() %>% ungroup() %>% pivot_wider(names_from = unit,values_from = c(t_mu, t_sigma),names_glue = "{.value}[{unit}]") %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("t_sigma"), starts_with("t_mu")), names_to = "variable",values_to = "value") %>% rename("sim" = "value") 

# Extract summary 
summary = map_dfr(fits, ~.x$sum, .id = 'run') %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run)) %>% filter(str_detect(variable, "t_mu\\[") | variable == "t_sigma"|variable =="t_mu_mu"|variable =="t_mu_sigma"| str_detect(variable, "t_sigma\\[")|variable =="t_sigma_mu_log"|variable =="t_sigma_sigma") %>% left_join(sim_param, by = c("run", "variable")) %>% left_join(dia, by = c("run"))

# plot all together
plot = ggplot(summary %>% filter(div ==0))+geom_point(aes(x=sim, y = mean, col = as.factor(div)))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=sim, ymin = q5, ymax = q95, col = as.factor(div)))+geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope =1, linetype = "dashed")+
  theme_classic()+facet_wrap(~variable, scales = 'free')
```

```{r}

###############
## pairsplot ##
###############

#params for the pairsplot

vars = c("t_mu_mu", "t_mu_sigma_log", "t_sigma_mu_log", "t_sigma_sigma_log", "t_mu[1]", "t_mu[2]", "t_sigma_log[1]", "t_sigma_log[2]")
run = 5

np = as_tibble(fits[[run]][["dia"]]) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw), 
    names_to = "Parameter",values_to = "Value") %>%rename(Chain = .chain, Iteration = .iteration) %>% 
  select(Parameter, Iteration, Chain, Value) %>% mutate(Parameter= factor(Parameter))


mcmc_pairs(fits[[run]][['draws']], pars = vars, np = np)
```
